name: Default
shortDescription: Dynamic DNS client that keeps A and AAAA records pointed at the server's public IP on Cloudflare, DuckDNS, Namecheap, OVH, Porkbun and 50+ other providers, with a status web UI.

alerts.message: Nothing is updated until you add your records to the config.json mount (one entry per provider and domain, as described in the provider docs) and redeploy. Use "ip_version": "ipv4" unless the server's container network has IPv6.
The web UI has no login: anyone who reaches the domain can see your records and IP history and call /update to force an update. Restrict access if that matters.
